All subsequent first coordinates remain units, so second differences vanish throughout the orbit. CRT supplies \(M\), cyclic group structure supplies order distribution, and \(\varphi(N)\) choices of starting units give exact rooted/unrooted counts. Exact-integer verification independently checks all moduli 2..160; finitude is not used for the unrestricted proof.
